text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text:
"Hmph, not bad at all.
Even if it was just a fluke, you somehow hit
upon the optimal solution."

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text:
An' what do you plan to do
with this massive pile of plushies?

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text:
"...Dotou looks like she'd like something like this,
so maybe I'll bring it to her."

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text:
For now, go find a bag somewhere
that can fit all these plushies. Hurry up.
